lead.question: 医生不肯透露手术结果，吉尔伯特先生用什么办法打听到了自己的病情？
lead.warmup: 住院的病人最想知道的，往往是手术到底成不成功。可在这篇课文里，医生偏偏不肯开口。约翰·吉尔伯特要了个床头电话，趁病房里只剩自己，拨通医院交换台，装作替“某位叫约翰·吉尔伯特的先生”打听病情。他真的能瞒住医生吗？答案藏在最后一句自报姓名里。
goals: 掌握 ask sb to do、refuse to do、ask for、inquire about、be allowed to do 等动词搭配
掌握 whether/if 与疑问词引导的间接疑问句：语序还原为陈述句、时态后退
能由间接疑问句还原直接引语，体会结尾自报姓名带来的幽默效果
lead.summary: 吉尔伯特住院时问医生手术是否成功，医生拒绝回答。第二天他要了床头电话，独自一人时拨通医院交换台，自称要打听“某位约翰·吉尔伯特先生”的病情。米灵顿医生告诉他手术很成功，病人还得再住两个星期，随后反问打电话者是不是病人的亲属。吉尔伯特只得回答“不是，我就是约翰·吉尔伯特”，伪装当场拆穿。
lead.tips: 转述一般疑问句必须用 whether/if，且要把倒装还原成陈述语序；another 后可接“数词+复数名词”，如 another two weeks。

questions.q: Why did Mr. Gilbert telephone the hospital exchange?
questions.zh: 吉尔伯特先生为什么打电话到医院交换台？
questions.a: Because his doctor refused to tell him whether his operation had been successful, so he asked for a bedside telephone and telephoned the hospital exchange, pretending to inquire about a certain patient named John Gilbert — himself.
questions.aZh: 因为医生拒绝告诉他手术是否成功，他就要了床头电话，装作打听“某位约翰·吉尔伯特先生”的病情，其实打听的是自己。
questions.hint: 见第 1 句 the doctor refused to do so 与第 2—4 句。

questions.q: What did the doctor refuse to do, and what does 'so' refer to?
questions.zh: 医生拒绝做什么？句中的 so 指代什么？
questions.a: He refused to tell Mr. Gilbert whether his operation had been successful; 'so' stands for the infinitive phrase 'to tell him whether his operation had been successful'.
questions.aZh: 医生拒绝告诉他手术是否成功；so 代替前面的不定式短语。

questions.q: How did the patient manage to speak to Doctor Millington?
questions.zh: 病人是怎样和米灵顿医生通上话的？
questions.a: The following day he asked for a bedside telephone; when he was alone, he telephoned the hospital exchange and asked for Doctor Millington.
questions.aZh: 第二天他要了一部床头电话；等病房里只剩他一个人时，他拨通医院的交换台，要求与米灵顿医生讲话。

questions.q: What two things did Dr. Millington tell the caller?
questions.zh: 米灵顿医生告诉打电话的人哪两件事？
questions.a: He told him that Mr. Gilbert's operation had been successful, and that Mr. Gilbert would have to stay in hospital for another two weeks.
questions.aZh: 一是手术很成功；二是还得在医院再住两个星期。

questions.q: Why is Dr. Millington's last question 'Are you a relative of the patient?' the key to the humour?
questions.zh: 为什么医生最后那句“你是病人的亲属吗”是全文的笑点所在？
questions.a: Because it forces the caller to choose between a lie and the truth: he cannot say yes, so he must admit 'I am Mr. John Gilbert' — the man who invented the fictitious patient turns out to be the patient himself.
questions.aZh: 因为这句话逼得他无法再装：说“是”是撒谎，说“不是”就只能承认“我就是约翰·吉尔伯特”，伪装当场露馅。
questions.hint: 结合结尾直接引语与前文 a certain patient。

exercises.q: 用所给动词的适当形式填空：he asked his doctor ______ (tell) him whether his operation had been successful, but the doctor refused ______ (do) so.
exercises.note: ask sb to do 与 refuse to do。

exercises.q: 词形填空：The ______ (follow) day, the patient asked for a bedside telephone.
把直接引语改为间接疑问句：'Has Mr. Gilbert's operation been successful?' he asked.
exercises.a: He asked whether (if) Mr. Gilbert's operation had been successful.

exercises.q: 把直接引语改为间接疑问句：'When will Mr. Gilbert be allowed to go home?' he asked.
exercises.a: He then asked when Mr. Gilbert would be allowed to go home.
exercises.note: 疑问词引导，倒装还原，will 变 would。

exercises.q: 把间接疑问句还原为直接引语：Dr. Millington asked the caller if he was a relative of the patient.
exercises.a: 'Are you a relative of the patient?' Dr. Millington asked the caller.

exercises.q: 汉译英：他打通医院的交换台，要求与米灵顿医生讲话。
exercises.a: He telephoned the hospital exchange and asked for Doctor Millington.

exercises.q: 改错：He said he was inquiring about certain patient, Mr. John Gilbert.
exercises.a: He said he was inquiring about a certain patient, a Mr. John Gilbert.

quiz.q: 第二天，这位病人要的是什么？
options: a bedside telephone
a private room
some medicine
his medical record
quiz.note: 原文：asked for a bedside telephone。

quiz.q: 吉尔伯特先生接通电话后，对米灵顿医生是怎么说的？
options: He said he was a relative of the patient.
He said he was inquiring about a certain patient, a Mr. John Gilbert.
He said the doctor had refused to see him.
He said he wanted another operation.

quiz.q: 哪一项正确转述了 “When will Mr. Gilbert be allowed to go home?”
options: He asked when Mr. Gilbert will be allowed to go home.
He asked when would Mr. Gilbert be allowed to go home.
He asked when Mr. Gilbert would be allowed to go home.
He asked that when Mr. Gilbert would be allowed to go home.
quiz.note: 疑问词引导，will 变 would，不能倒装。

quiz.q: 米灵顿医生最后问打电话的人什么？
options: whether he was a relative of the patient
whether he was the patient's doctor
when the operation had begun
where the patient was living
quiz.note: 原文：asked the caller if he was a relative。

quiz.q: “a certain patient” 中的 certain 在这里是什么意思？
options: sure
some particular (某一位)
important
unknown to everybody

quiz.q: “他在医院还必须再住两个星期”的正确英文是？
options: He would have to stay in hospital for another two week.
He would have to stay in hospital for two another weeks.
He would have to stay in hospital for other two weeks.
He would have to stay in hospital for another two weeks.
quiz.note: another 可接“数词+复数名词”。
